string-array.item: Use sunscreen every day, even indoors near windows.
Moisturise within 3 minutes of bathing to lock in water.
Patch-test new products on your inner arm for 48 hours.
Take scan photos in daylight, 15–20 cm from the skin.
Short, lukewarm baths are kinder to the skin barrier.

SkinNova is for preliminary information and education. It does not replace a professional medical diagnosis.

Image model trained on: PAD-UFES-20 (CC BY 4.0), SkinDisNet (CC BY-NC 4.0), DermNet NZ images via a Kaggle mirror (non-commercial, educational), the mgmitesh Kaggle set (CC BY 4.0) and SCIN by Google Research and Stanford Medicine (CC BY 4.0, crowdsourced phone photos). Tested on SkinDiseaseBD (CC BY-NC 4.0). Language model: Gemma 4 E2B (Apache-2.0), fine-tuned for SkinNova. Condition notes summarise AAD, NHS, DermNet and WHO public pages in our own words.

Most training photos are clinical close-ups of lighter skin. On an outside test of phone photos of brown skin, the right condition was among the top 3 in about 2 of 3 cases, and eczema was often missed. The image model knows 10 broad categories (11 condition notes). Voice input in languages other than Hindi and English is beta. Treat every result as a starting point for talking to a doctor. The explanation model relies mostly on the image model\'s scores and your answers, not on reading the photo itself. Spot tracking measures size best with a coin in both photos (typical error about 6% in tests, sometimes much larger); without one, size changes are shown with low confidence.
